recent_excerpts: Analog Devices disclosed to the SEC that intruders exfiltrated files from its networks in June, with scope still unknown.
Kaspersky dissects GenieLocker, a custom ransomware from the Toy Ghouls group, targeting Windows, Linux, and ESXi in attacks on Russian manufacturing firms since March 2026.
Latvia's LVM says 44 GB of data leaked, two-thirds of customers still locked out of systems after ransomware attack attributed to a foreign financially motivated group.
